content_units: This gives a total shared overlap of   90 minutes  , which is enough to fit:
- with   at least 90 minutes between meetings   if the second meeting does   not   require all 4 people
Meeting   Time (New York)   Duration   Attendees   Purpose
Launch checklist review     11:00 AM-12:00 PM     60 min   Me, Designer, Engineer, PM   Final cross-functional launch readiness review
Follow-up decisions sync     1:30 PM-2:00 PM     30 min   Me, Designer, PM   Resolve open items after engineering handoff
- The full-team meeting fits inside the only 4-way overlap:   11:00-12:30
- The follow-up starts   90 minutes after   the first meeting ends
- The second meeting fits the availability of:
- The engineer is unavailable after   12:30 PM  , so a same-day 4-person follow-up is   not possible
- Confirm launch date, scope, and success criteria
- Walk through checklist status by function: design, engineering, product
- Review blockers, bugs, approvals, and dependencies
- Assign owners and deadlines for any remaining gaps
- Decide:   ready to launch / ready with conditions / not ready
- Reconfirm actions opened in the first meeting
- Make PM/designer/me decisions that do not require engineer attendance
- Finalize communications, approvals, and rollout steps
- Capture end-of-day owner list and next checkpoints
- A same-day plan with both meetings including   all 4 participants   is   not feasible
- The proposed follow-up assumes it can be a smaller working session after the engineer drops
If you want the most efficient alternative, this is the cleanest sequence:

rows: Resolve open items after engineering handoff
